rv.q: [Cattrall has] been paired off here with Paul Gross, who matches her in both light-comedy physicality and major sexual chemistry...after decades of revivals that exploited Coward's most popular comedy as a sideshow for aging actresses with something to prove, this one keeps the stakes up at what Coward calls the 'big tables.'
Gross is the evening's highlight, with his flawless lacquer of disdain broken only by eruptions of mania.
But Ms. Cattrall's earthbound performance keeps it from taking wing
And while it isn't the kind of quote theater producers like to slap on advertising posters, it is meant as a compliment.
